**Prior Degrees:** Mechanical Engineer, Universidad de Chile, 2021

Vicente joined the CCWJ the year 2021 as a visiting student and came back in 2022 to start his MSc programm. Vicente comes from Chile, where he holds the degree of Mechanical Engineer from the Universidad de Chile. His interest in welding started the year 2019 when he took a welding course with Lincoln Electric in Chile. He received the ELAP scholarship, that allowed him to travel to Canada and work on the CCWJ.

Vicente is part of the AWS/CWBA Student Chapter comitee and is working on making new opportunities for his colleages back in Chile.

Vicente has been a volleyball player his entire life and now is exploring new parts of the world with his bike. As a sportman, he is always happy to do sports with friends!

#### Project

Vicente's research started in 2021 with his internship where he was able to develop work regarding an energy balance in Gas Metal Arc Welding. His research was finally his undergraduate thesis and now as a MSc. student he is working on the same field. This energy balance is allowing to understand the theory behind the droplet temperature and anode fall voltage.
